questions.question: Who gives the most money to Labor?
questions.lead: Across disclosed returns from 1998–99 to 2025–26 in OPAX’s published selection, Westpac Banking Corporation was the source of the largest disclosed receipts to Labor: $55,227,183. These federal totals mix donations with other receipts such as loans, so this is not a donation ranking.

questions.question: Which banks lent money to Labor?
questions.lead: The published debt records cannot establish a complete list of banks that lent money to Labor. They report balances owed at 30 June, rather than amounts newly lent, and name only the latest year’s largest creditors.
